verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only first-party instrumentation (the JavaScript SDK and the HTTP/Pixel APIs) and Reverse ETL from the customer's own warehouse, data lake, or database. Nothing in the pack shows connectors that pull data from third-party cloud apps or feeds, such as SaaS ETL sources or webhook sources. The HTTP API is a developer building block and warehouse sync is an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit toward this story.
